articles.author: Donica Phifer
articles.title: Google Maps switches to "Lake America" as Canada compares change to SNL skit - Axios
articles.description: "No one's going to call it Lake of America. It's been Lake Ontario for hundreds of years," Ontario Premier Doug Ford said.
articles.content:
Driving the news: An Axios review of Google and Apple Maps on Sunday showed Google now says "Lake America" on mobile and desktop, while Apple Maps says Lake Ontario.
